For those who are wondering why it happens;

He fills the tube with water, puts the empty can upside down and then his finger to the hole of the can so that water doesnt get inside the can when he presses the can into to the water. Then he turns the tube upside down(still covering the hole in the can cuz this makes sure theres only air inside the can and water doesnt get in.). Now when he lets go of the can the can moves up cuz it has a low relative density because of the air trapped in the can. Now it floates on the surface of the water.
